subject: Speed-up: read docs/REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md before done; local e2e = smoke set only, full matrix on CI
body: Effective now for implementers and reviewers. Local e2e runs only webkit-ipad-portrait, webkit-ipad-landscape, webkit-phone-390, chromium-laptop-1440 (2x, --retries=0). The full 3x6 matrix is judged from the CI run on claude/naadi-shared — link it. Run the checklist and list results in your done message. New segments will run in separate cloud sessions (own machine): same ledger and shared branch.
